classes.name: Dedication
classes.description: Those who follow the path of Dedication master martial combat through discipline and training. Combining the versatility of a warrior with the focused precision of a monk, Dedication embodies the perfection of body and mind through endless practice.

1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: Choose a fighting style: Archery (+2 ranged attack rolls), Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed melee weapon), Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s on two-handed weapon damage), Mariner (traverse deep water, +1 AC if no heavy armor/shield), or Unarmed Fighting (1d6 unarmed strikes, 1d8 if both hands free).

1.name: Steady Nerve
1.description: As a bonus action, choose one of the following options: Heal (regain 1d8 + your Dedication level + CON modifier HP), Attack (make one weapon attack), Dash (double movement this turn), Disengage (movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks), or Dodge (attackers have disadvantage until start of your next turn). Once per short rest.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: You master 3 weapons of your choice. You can use the mastery property of any weapon you're proficient with and have mastered.

2.name: Action Surge
2.description: Take one additional action on your turn. Once per short rest (twice at 17th level).

2.name: Stamina
2.description: You gain stamina points equal to your WIS modifier (minimum 1). Use stamina to fuel special techniques: Flurry of Blows (2 unarmed strikes as bonus action for 1 stamina), Patient Defense (Dodge as bonus action for 1 stamina), or Step of the Wind (Disengage or Dash as bonus action for 1 stamina).

2.name: Unarmored Movement
2.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing armor or wielding a shield.

3.name: Deflect Missiles
3.description: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, use your reaction to reduce damage by 1d10 + DEX modifier + your level. If you reduce it to 0, you can catch the missile and spend 1 stamina to throw it back (20/60 range).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 stamina to force a CON save (DC 8 + proficiency + WIS mod). On failure, target is stunned until the end of your next turn.

classes.name: Scholar
classes.description: Scholars are masters of arcane knowledge, blending theoretical mastery with practical innovation. Combining the spellcasting prowess of wizards with the inventive genius of artificers, Scholars bend reality through intellect and ingenuity.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast wizard spells using INT as your spellcasting ability. You prepare spells from your spellbook each long rest (INT modifier + level spells prepared).

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover spell slots with combined level ≤ half your level (rounded up). No slot can be 6th level or higher.

1.name: Magical Tinkering
1.description: Imbue tiny objects with minor magical effects (light, recorded sound, odor, static image). Can have a number of objects active equal to your INT modifier.

2.name: Infuse Item
2.description: Imbue mundane items with magic. You know 4 infusion recipes and can have 2 items infused at once. Infusions last until your next long rest.

3.name: The Right Tool for the Job
3.description: Over 1 hour with tinker's tools, create a set of artisan's tools. The tools vanish when you create a new set.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Tool Expertise
5.description: Double your proficiency bonus for ability checks made with tools you're proficient with.

classes.name: Pact
classes.description: Those who walk the path of Pact draw power from otherworldly beings and divine entities. Merging the devotion of clerics with the forbidden knowledge of warlocks, Pact wielders channel forces beyond mortal comprehension.

pactMagic.description: In addition to normal spell slots, you have Pact Magic slots that recover on short rest.

1.name: Divine Spellcasting
1.description: Cast cleric spells using WIS. You prepare spells each long rest (WIS modifier + level spells).

1.name: Pact Magic
1.description: You have 1 Pact Magic slot (recovers on short rest) that you can use to cast warlock spells. Pact slots are always cast at the highest level you can cast.

1.name: Eldritch Blast
1.description: You know the Eldritch Blast cantrip, a beam of crackling energy (1d10 force damage, ranged spell attack).

2.name: Channel Divinity
2.description: Channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. Choose: Turn Undead (force WIS save, turned on fail) or Preserve Life (heal 5 × level HP, divided among allies within 30 feet). Recovers on short rest.

2.name: Eldritch Invocations
2.description: Learn 2 invocations - fragments of forbidden knowledge that grant ongoing benefits. Examples: Agonizing Blast (+CHA to Eldritch Blast damage), Devil's Sight (see in magical darkness), Armor of Shadows (cast Mage Armor at will).

3.name: Pact Boon
3.description: Your patron bestows a gift. Choose: Pact of the Chain (familiar), Pact of the Blade (summon weapon), or Pact of the Tome (ritual spellbook).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
5.description: When undead of CR 1/2 or lower fail their save against Turn Undead, they are instantly destroyed.

classes.name: Wanderlust
classes.description: Wanderlust represents those driven by curiosity and freedom, masters of versatility who refuse to be bound by convention. Combining the cunning of rogues with the charisma of bards, they are jack-of-all-trades who excel through adaptability.

1.name: Expertise
1.description: Choose 2 skills you're proficient in. Double your proficiency bonus for those skills. Choose 2 more at 6th level.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, deal extra 1d6 damage when you hit with advantage or an ally is within 5 feet of target. Must use finesse or ranged weapon.

1.name: Bardic Inspiration
1.description: Grant an ally a d6 inspiration die they can add to an ability check, attack roll, or save within 10 minutes. Uses = CHA modifier per short rest.

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: Use a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

2.name: Jack of All Trades
2.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

2.name: Song of Rest
2.description: During a short rest, allies who spend hit dice to heal regain an extra 1d6 HP.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: Use Cunning Action bonus action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools to disarm traps/pick locks, or Use an Object.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage.

classes.name: Bond
classes.description: Bond represents those who form deep connections with the natural world and its creatures. Merging the tracking prowess of rangers with the primal magic of druids, they are protectors of wilderness and champions of balance.

1.name: Favored Enemy
1.description: Choose a creature type (beasts, fey, humanoids, undead, etc.). Advantage on tracking and Intelligence checks to recall info about them.

1.name: Natural Explorer
1.description: Choose a terrain type (forest, grassland, mountain, etc.). Double proficiency bonus on INT and WIS checks related to that terrain.

1.name: Druidic
1.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can leave hidden messages in natural settings that only druids can read.

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description: Choose Archery (+2 ranged attack rolls), Defense (+1 AC in armor), or Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed weapon).

2.name: Spellcasting
2.description: Cast ranger and druid spells using WIS. You know a number of spells based on your level.

2.name: Wild Shape
2.description: Transform into a beast with CR 1/4 or lower (CR 1/2 at 4th level, CR 1 at 8th level). Lasts for hours = half your level. Use twice per short rest.

3.name: Primeval Awareness
3.description: Use an action and a spell slot to sense creatures within 1 mile (6 miles in favored terrain) for 1 minute per spell level. Sense: aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

classes.name: Oath
classes.description: Oath represents warriors bound by sacred vows, wielding divine power through conviction. Merging the holy might of paladins with the blood magic of blood hunters, they are relentless crusaders who pay a price for power.

1.name: Divine Sense
1.description: Sense celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet. Know their location and type. Uses = 1 + CHA modifier per long rest.

1.name: Lay on Hands
1.description: You have a healing pool of HP = 5 × your level. As an action, touch a creature to restore HP from this pool (max = pool size). Cure disease/poison for 5 HP. Pool refills on long rest.

1.name: Crimson Rite
1.description: As a bonus action, imbue a weapon with hemocraft energy. Take damage = 1 hit die (no roll). The weapon deals +1d4 damage (fire, cold, lightning, or necrotic) until you finish a rest.

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description: Choose Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 damage one-handed), or Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s).

2.name: Spellcasting
2.description: Cast paladin spells using CHA. Prepare spells each long rest (CHA modifier + half your level).

2.name: Divine Smite
2.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal +2d8 radiant damage (1st level) + 1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8). +1d8 vs undead/fiends.

3.name: Sacred Oath
3.description: Choose an oath: Devotion (protection and virtue), Vengeance (punish wrongdoers), or Redemption (peace and mercy). Gain oath spells and Channel Divinity options.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

5.name: Brand of Castigation
5.description: When you damage a creature with Crimson Rite, you can brand it. Branded creatures can't become invisible and you have advantage on attacks against them. Brand lasts until the end of your next turn.

classes.name: Instinct
classes.description: Instinct embodies raw, primal power channeled through emotion and will. Merging the savage fury of barbarians with the innate magic of sorcerers, they are forces of nature who bend reality through sheer force of personality.

1.name: Rage
1.description: Enter a rage as a bonus action for 1 minute. Gain advantage on STR checks/saves, +2 melee damage, resistance to physical damage. Can't cast spells while raging. 2 rages per long rest.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While not wearing armor, your AC = 10 + DEX modifier + CON modifier + shield (if wielding).

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: Cast sorcerer spells using CHA as your spellcasting ability. You know a number of cantrips and spells based on your level.

2.name: Reckless Attack
2.description: On your first attack each turn, gain advantage on all melee attack rolls. Attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

2.name: Danger Sense
2.description: Advantage on DEX saves against effects you can see (traps, spells) while not blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

2.name: Font of Magic
2.description: You have sorcery points = your level. Use them to create spell slots or fuel metamagic. Recover on long rest.

3.name: Primal Path
3.description: Choose a path: Path of the Berserker (relentless fury), Path of the Totem Warrior (animal spirits), or Path of Wild Magic (chaotic surges).

3.name: Metamagic
3.description: Learn 2 metamagic options to modify your spells. Examples: Quickened Spell (cast as bonus action for 2 sorcery points), Empowered Spell (reroll damage dice for 1 point), Twinned Spell (target 2 creatures for sorcery points = spell level).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Max 20.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

5.name: Fast Movement
5.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.
